about_short_description.short_description: Oneness Labs is a Web3 gaming infrastructure company.

product.name: Oneness Matrix
product.description: A fully-encapsulated operating system for gaming that includes the chain layer, protocol layer, and service layer, ensuring the authenticity and integrity of web3 gaming.

product.name: Oneness Adapter
product.description: An intent-centric product offering modularized and encapsulated protocols such as token swaps, NFT AMM, bridges, and stablecoins, designed as an easy plug-in for game developers.

product.name: Oneness Abstraction Wallet
product.description: A wallet solution for gamers to manage both on-chain and off-chain assets across games, featuring user-centric options like social media or email account login.

product.name: zkVRP
product.description: A decentralized network generating verifiable on-chain random variables to ensure the independence and fairness of game mechanisms and in-game core assets using zero-knowledge proof.
